title: Zustand Small Examples
description: Use these small Zustand examples with the tools described in each lesson. Read the expected result before you try a change.

examples.title: Create a small store
examples.description: A Zustand store groups values and actions.

examples.title: Select one value
examples.description: A selector chooses the store value a component needs.
examples.code:
import {useReading} from "./store.js"; export default function Count(){const count=useReading(state=>state.count);return

Books: {count}

;}
examples.output: The component displays the count from the store created in the first lesson.

examples.title: Call an action from a button
examples.description: An action is a function stored alongside the values.
examples.code:
import {useReading} from "./store.js";
export default function Add(){const add=useReading(state=>state.add);return <button onClick={add}>Read one</button>;}
examples.output: Clicking the button runs the store action and increases the count.

examples.title: Base an update on current state
examples.description: A set callback receives the current state.

examples.title: Update one top-level field
examples.description: By default, set merges the supplied top-level fields into state.
examples.output: The name is still Garden after count changes.

examples.title: Copy a nested object
examples.description: A nested object needs its own copy when you change one of its fields.
examples.output: The name changes to Sam while the colour stays blue.

examples.title: Add an item without changing the old array
examples.description: A new array can keep the old items and add one more.
examples.output: The list now has one book.

examples.title: Calculate a derived count
examples.description: A selector can calculate a value from stored data.
examples.code:
import {useBooks} from "./book-store.js"; export default function Unread(){const count=useBooks(state=>state.books.filter(book=>!book.read).length);return

{count} unread books

;}
examples.output: The component counts unread records from the real book-store export.

examples.title: Use a store without React
examples.description: A vanilla Zustand store can be used by ordinary JavaScript.
examples.output: The value is 4 without needing a React component.

examples.title: Listen and then unsubscribe
examples.description: subscribe runs a listener after store changes.
examples.output: The listener prints 1. It does not print 2 after stop is called.

examples.title: Save a browser preference
examples.description: The persist middleware can store selected state in browser storage.
examples.output: The theme choice can survive a reload where localStorage is available.

examples.title: Reset only the intended data
examples.description: A reset action should set the values that belong to its feature.
examples.output: The reading values return to their starting values and the reset action remains available.
